c1_pier_level2: Qingyu Port · Sector B, low tide
c1_signoff_exam: Qingyu Port · Shift change, sectors A and B

lines.pier_open: Shore Yeh. Three piles. I need thickness readings.
lines.pier_establish: Short payout. No wide turns in the murk.
lines.pier_task: R-One, low vis. One point at a time.
lines.pier_nudge: R-One, can you frame both dots and the outer edge?
lines.pier_near: Stand off about seven tenths of visibility.
lines.pier_contact: Contact. Back off and line up again.
lines.pier_murky: Silt's up. Wait for a clear reading.
lines.pier_timeout: Tide window's up. Mark the unmeasured cells.
lines.pier_settle_bronze: Numbers complete. Photos a little soft.
lines.pier_settle_abort: Back aboard. We'll reschedule the missing points.
lines.pier_report: Shore copies. Night crew can pick a scraper from that shot.
lines.hull_establish: I'll watch the line at the opening.
lines.hull_task: Outline of the opening first. Stay out of dark gaps.
lines.hull_nudge: R-One, check the section you're on first.
lines.hull_loto: Vessel confirms pumps and prop locked out.
lines.hull_nearProp: Prop area. Confirm it's stopped first.
lines.hull_suction: Silt's up. Back to the last visible outline.
lines.hull_timeout: Close this section. Send the gaps to the vessel.
lines.hull_settle_gold: All ratings in. No fouled line.
lines.hull_settle_silver: Deliverable. Rushed part of the flat bottom.
lines.hull_settle_bronze: Accepted. Prop shot's a little distant.
lines.hull_settle_abort: Safe return first. We'll rebook the hull.
lines.hull_report: Management needs the ratings. Send them my way.
lines.drop_establish: Keep the line clear of debris.
lines.drop_task: Engineers need their instrument. Do what you can.
lines.drop_nudge: R-One, back to the last completed sweep.
lines.drop_decoy: R-One, look at the outline. The instrument has a handle.
lines.drop_timeout: Save the search log. Leave uncertain returns open.
lines.drop_settle_silver: Found it. Took the long way round.
lines.drop_settle_abort: Right call. Say what you couldn't verify.
lines.sign_open: I need the files before handover.
lines.sign_nudge: R-One, see the seam from the old shot?
lines.sign_snag: R-One, line is tight. Retrace your track.
lines.sign_timeout: Shore, final records. I'll list what's missing.
lines.sign_settle_gold: Matched the angles. Kept the window.
lines.sign_settle_silver: Good for handover. Sound judgment on timing.
lines.sign_settle_bronze: Just usable. One angle was off.
lines.sign_settle_abort: Right. Safe return. Log the reason.
